about.title: The Rosetta Stone for Generational Slang
about.subtitle: Bridge the communication gap between Gen Alpha and Gen X.
about.feature1Desc: All slang from both generations in one searchable card grid with generation badges and filters.
about.feature2Desc: Two-panel translator that converts Gen Alpha slang to Gen X and vice versa in real time.
about.feature3Desc: Matched pairs showing how the same concept was expressed across generations.
about.feature4Desc: Test your knowledge with quizzes that ask for equivalents across generations.
about.feature5Desc: Search across terms, definitions, and aliases from both generations simultaneously.
about.feature6Desc: Filter by generation, category, and vibe score to find exactly what you need.
about.step1Desc: Explore all slang from both generations with rich cards showing definitions, examples, vibe scores, and cross-generation equivalents.
about.step2Desc: Paste text into the translator and see recognized slang highlighted with their cross-generation equivalents.
about.step3Desc: Take the cross-generational quiz to see if you can speak both languages fluently.
